description:
Create a one-time link to a cart on nb8floral.com pre-filled with the given products.
    Nothing is charged: the cart is reviewed and paid on nb8floral.com. Quantities are rounded up
    to whole packs and prices are recalculated from today's data. The link works once and expires
    after 30 minutes. Ships to the contiguous US only. Items that can't be added (pre-order, price
    on request, not enough stock) are returned in needs_quote.

slug.description: Product slug (pre-order items can't be added to a cart).
